title: Cyberwave Simulation Feature Profile
description: The versioned set of control modes, state fields, sensor modalities, media and readiness requirements a simulation runtime must satisfy for a workload. Identified by (profile_id, version); a runtime reports the profile it implements in simulation.runtime_audit.v1.feature_profile_id. Not an options map: every requirement is a named field.

profile_id.description: Stable identifier of this profile, e.g. 'isaac.core'. Combined with version it names an immutable requirement set.

backend.description: Canonical simulation backend the profile applies to.

execution_profile.description: Isaac execution profile, or null for backends without execution profiles.

control_modes.description: Mandatory Cyberwave control modes, by existing command name (e.g. joint_position, joint_velocity, gripper, locomotion_velocity, aerial_velocity, gimbal). Each mode must be mapped explicitly per asset; an unmapped mode fails preflight and is never approximated.

state_fields.description: Mandatory state fields by dotted name (e.g. joint.position, joint.velocity, joint.effort, base.pose, base.twist).

sensor_modalities.description: Mandatory sensor modalities; a listed modality the scene does not provide reports missing at readiness. Thermal and audio are not profile modalities: the Isaac runtime renders thermal cameras and routes microphones and speakers for whichever twins declare them, without a profile entry. New modalities are added to this enum additively.

webrtc.description: Frames enter the existing Cyberwave WebRTC/media path.

recording.description: Existing recording selection and run association work.

limits.description: Declared operating limits. Open for additive limits.

required_first_samples.description: Capabilities (sensor ids, modalities or state streams) whose first valid sample is required before the runtime reports ready.
